newsitem.title: USA: Vintage Petroleum files for notes, stock.
newsitem.headline: Vintage Petroleum files for notes, stock.

text.p: Vintage Petroleum Inc said Friday it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $100 million in senior subordinated notes due 2009 and 1.5 million in common stock.

The company granted underwriters an over-allotment option to purchase up to 225,000 common shares. The offering will be made through Salomon Brothers, Dillon Read & Co Inc, Lehman Brothers and Nesbitt Burns Securities Inc.
Proceeds from the concurrent offering will be used to repay a portion of existing indebtedness under the company's revolving credit facility, Vintage said.
Vintage is an independent oil and gas company focused on the acquisition of producing oil and gas properities which contain the potential for increased value through exploration and development.
